evidence: Full audit across all 55,750 rows confirmed target_aqi_24h matches aqi_curr at timestamp t+24h with 0 mismatches. Delta is strictly 24 hours.
Test set mean AQI is 379.22 (91.5% samples >= 300, 41.9% >= 400) vs Train mean 177.96 (only 12.5% >= 300, 1.4% >= 400). Severe regime shift.
Nov-Dec experiences persistent multi-week boundary layer compression and stubble emissions. High AQI persists (+9.2 mean delta in 300-400 bin) vs spring mean-reversion (-24.7 delta in train).
Ordinal features (month 1-8 in train, 11-12 in test; day_of_year 1-243 in train, 305-364 in test) caused trees to route winter test samples into monsoon leaves (AQI ~80-100).
GBDTs predict constant leaf values and cannot extrapolate beyond training bounds. Max test prediction was 347.61 while true values reached 500.

hypothesis: F. Raw AQI Regression vs Delta Formulation
evidence: Predicting raw AQI forces trees to learn absolute baseline from non-representative train data. Delta formulation (AQI(t+24)-AQI(t)) anchors on AQI(t) and cuts test error significantly.

hypothesis: G. Regularization & Extrapolation in Linear Models
evidence: Regularized Ridge regression (alpha=1000) achieves Test MAE 38.15 and Test Bias -9.71, beating Naive Persistence (38.34) without tree extrapolation ceiling.
